title: PAF tclaude extension 1.x: the value of extensions.tclaude on each object
description: Which properties apply depends on the object carrying the extension; see the PAF spec. Unknown properties are allowed.

spawn_profile.description: agent.json: tclaude inline spawn profile, including launch posture.

name.description: Informational; receivers never look a profile up by name.

permissions.description: agent.json: advisory permission provenance; never grants.

sandbox.description: environment.json: tclaude sandbox details behind the tclaude layer.

harness.description: environment.json: settings only one harness has, keyed by harness name.

group.description: group.json: group settings such as standing orders and routes.

owner.description: group.json member: advisory; ownership never travels.

transfer.description: agent.json: continuation state for move and teleport.

identity.description: Stable federation identity of a continuation (agent, home, hops, proofs).

carry_permissions.description: The sender opted in to carrying permissions; the receiver still decides.

trigger.description: What started the transfer, such as teleport or move.

item.description: environment.json placeholder: the configuration item the placeholder stands in.

field.description: environment.json placeholder: the field of that item.

converted_from.description: manifest root: the legacy carrier this PAF was converted from.
